generation_parents.algorithm: Replace the absolute epsilon-band near-tie gate (5e-2*span) with a scale-free relative band gate (1e-3 * max(1,|best_score|)) that fires more often, widening the near-tie window so the capacity-fit refinement step participates more frequently while keeping base = d_cur - 0.6*d_dep as the primary ordering, with tie-breaking by max demand, then min base score, then min current distance, then min base.
